title: A Kimi session's detached full gate is refused credit: "its command at completion did not match its start"
outcome: A Kimi (ACP) root session can launch the full gate in a supported way and have its terminal result recorded as a host verification, or the refusal names a launch shape that will be credited.
acceptance: The cause is classified with evidence: which command text the host saw at start and at completion for a Kimi detached gate, and why they differ.

A documented launch shape for Kimi root sessions gets a passing detached full gate recorded as a host verification, or the refusal names that shape; a test covers the start/completion matching for Kimi's reported commands.
